text: The Meghalaya Identification, Registration (Safety & Security) of Migrant Workers Act, 2020 (Act No. 14 of 2020) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202014 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2020-09-15 Act Year: 2020 Short Title: The Meghalaya Identification, Registration (Safety & Security) of Migrant Workers Act, 2020 (Act No. 14 of 2020) Long Title: An Act to provide for the maintenance of public order and for the protection and safety of Migrant Workers in the State of Meghalaya, by identification and mandatory registration of all such workers in the State. And to prevent the commission of offences of harassment, intimidation, discrimination and such other act or omission that may affect the safety and security of Migrant Workers, and to further ensure the safety and security of all Migrant Workers during the course of employment within the State of Meghalaya and for matters connected therewith.
